answers.explanation: Sender Policy Framework: IP addresses and includes of permitted senders.
-all is a hard fail. ~all is the softer version.
SPF checks the envelope domain from MAIL FROM:. DMARC is what ties things to the visible From:.
A forwarder's IP isn't in the original domain's SPF, but the DKIM signature still matches.
reject. quarantine sends it to spam, and none just reports.
Start at p=none, read the rua reports, fix every legitimate sender, then tighten to quarantine and reject.
